metadata.label: Note(s)
metadata.value:
According to Mingana, the author is the same as Buṭrus al-Tūlāwi, a Maronite priest who died in Aleppo in 1745. He was educated in a Maronite school of Rome. (Cf. Catalogue Manuscrits Auteurs Arabes Chrétiens Depuis L'Islam by Louis Cheikho (Bayrūt: Maṭbaʻat al-Ābāʼ al-Yasūʻīyīn 1924), page. 76.

The work is divided into eigtheen baḥths, subdivided into an unequal number of faṣls.

Folios 1b-4b: index.

Folios 213a-216a: a definition of philosophical and theological terms. Headed "التعاريف الموجودة في هذا المجلد"

metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: A work on Logic by the priest Buṭrus bin Buṭrus bin Isḥaq al-Tūlāti of Aleppo. The manuscript is not dated but Mingana puts the date of production around 1750 CE based on the handwriting.

metadata.label: Provenance
metadata.value:
Formerly in the collection of Alexander Lindsay, 25th Earl of Crawford (1812–1880).

Previously in the collection of Alphonse Mingana (1881-1937), Syriac and Christian Arabic scholar and Chaldean priest who acquired his collection in the 1920 in Egypt, Syria and Iraq.

metadata.label: Author(s)
